summary: Email pipeline reliability: per-client isolation, stream split (transactional vs marketing), input validation, rate-limit kill-switch

ai.s: Hardens the email pipeline so one client's bounces cannot stop email for everyone, with separate transactional and marketing streams, validation and scoped kill-switches.

ai.oc: Planned: split transactional and marketing streams on separate SES identities, per-client isolation, validation of addresses before SES, and a per-client-scoped kill-switch.

summary: Admin notifications: hybrid idempotency (DB UNIQUE + post-FCM Redis flag)

ai.s: Makes admin notification sending retry-safe with a DB unique constraint and a post-FCM Redis flag, so users get neither duplicate pushes nor missed ones.
ai.pr: The Redis lock set before insert and push meant a worker crash mid-batch made SQS retries skip the whole batch, so users silently missed in-app records and pushes for 24 hours.
ai.wy: Removes the accepted trade-off from EP-53440 between duplicate pushes and silent delivery loss.
ai.oc: A UNIQUE index with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING protects in-app records, and a per-user Redis flag set after successful FCM dispatch skips only users already notified.
